page_images.inspection: Distinct salt/thiosulfate formulation, with no explicit final-volume heading. Main recipe has 0.50 ml resazurin 0.1% w/v and 20 ml neutralized sulfide 3% w/v. Sulfide preparation lists 3 g nonahydrate plus 100 ml water and dropwise 2 M sulfuric acid to pH about 7; the vessel size 250 ml is not final solution volume.

Final volume 1005 ml and pH 6.0 are printed explicitly. Main-table inputs and growth-factor masses match extraction. Growth factors are grams, not milliliters. DSM 16661/21157 omit the entire growth-factor stock and use 2 bar after inoculation. The base uses 1 bar and 110 C for 20 minutes; do not confuse stock pH 9 with medium pH 6.

SL-10 explicitly makes up to 1000 ml; 25% HCl has no percentage basis. Selenium/tungsten and seven-vitamin tables list water inputs, not explicit final stock volumes. Dithionite heading states 5% w/v; NaOH is 0.50 ml of 1 N, not 0.50 g. Water is 9.50 ml. Growth-factor NaOH is titrated to pH 9 without an amount.
Continues dithionite preparation from page 2: dark/cool storage and small freshly prepared amounts because it decomposes rapidly. No additional ingredient rows or final-volume statement.
